## 

```{bash setup}
#| echo: fasle
#| eval: false

#working directory on the cluster: ~/rna_seq

#link to my data
ln -s /home/ham14/data/SRR35819952_* .
```

```{bash}
#| label: download
#| echo: false
#| eval: true

#Download the dataset
fasterq-dump SRR35819952

#gzip dataset
gzip SRR35819952_?.fastq

```

```{QC}
#| echo: false
#| eval: false

#Run QC
fastqc SRR35819952_?.fastq.gz
```

```{Trim and Rerun QC}
#| echo: false
#| eval: false

#Trim
trimmomatic PE -threads 1 \
  SRR35819952_1.fastq.gz SRR35819952_2.fastq.gz \
  r1_trim.fastq.gz r1_trim_unpaired.fastq.gz \
  r2_trim.fastq.gz r2_trim_unpaired.fastq.gz \
  SLIDINGWINDOW:4:20
  MINLEN:25
  
#Re-run QC
fastqc r?_trim.fastq.gz
```
